result.summary: The layout is largely sound, but there is a visible spelling error in the search field, inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) buttons between restaurant cards, and a mismatched thumbnail treatment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/near-black circular button with a white outline heart.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (same background fill, icon color, size and opacity) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a light gray background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven; its white 15–25 min pill also has low contrast against the light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image backgrounds (or apply a consistent dark gradient overlay behind the time badge) so all carousel items read the same and badges stay legible.
